evals.prompt: Review docs/plans/user-api-rbac.md before we implement it. Fix wording issues, but show me any changes that alter the authorization model before editing those parts.
evals.expected_output: Reads the full named plan, provides the structured assessment and scorecard, applies only minor edits, identifies at most one must-address issue, and asks approval before any authorization-model change.

evals.prompt: Can you review the latest plan in this repo and make sure it is ready to implement? Keep it simple and don't add future features.
evals.expected_output: Finds the newest document under docs/plans or docs/brainstorms, reports the selected path, evaluates clarity/completeness/specificity/YAGNI, avoids scope expansion, and updates the original file only as allowed.

evals.prompt: We just finished agreeing on the role-management workflow. Review the plan against our discussion, remove harmless ambiguity, and flag anything that would change the decisions we made.
evals.expected_output: Includes user-intent fidelity, distinguishes minor ambiguity fixes from substantive decision changes, does not rewrite the plan, and ends by offering Refine again or Review complete after changes are resolved.
